question_record.context: As part of a recent security incident involving credential theft using Mimikatz and lateral movement, the Mimikatz tool was detected and various command lines involving `mimikatz.exe` were executed to harvest credentials and potentially log into other devices on the network. Subsequently, a sign-in attempt was detected using a deceptive user account on this device, which might be part of the attack activities aimed at lateral movement and accessing sensitive data.
question_record.question: What was the IP address used in the deceptive user account sign-in attempt?
solution: Mimikatz credential theft tool was detected on a device and an account with SID `S-5-7-21-1843151660-3234030288-105586167-1422` might be compromised.
A sign-in attempt was detected using a deceptive user account named `kyleg`.
The sign-in attempt using the deceptive user account `kyleg` originated from the IP address `141.216.110.153`.

108.name: Mimikatz credential theft tool
108.description:
The Mimikatz hacktool was detected on this device. Mimikatz is a credential theft tool that can harvest plaintext passwords, password hashes, smartcard PINs, and Kerberos tickets.  An attacker might be trying to harvest credentials to log into this or other devices on the network, by impersonating a valid user.

For more information, read the Mimikatz tool profile Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/51db19ab-081f-46f3-9fe1-3f5e5d2f8ee0/analystreport? and read the Actor profile: Storm-0875 Threat Analytics report https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/4f60801d-912e-4bcb-91b2-f46879c8a718/analystreport

41.name: Sign-in attempt with deceptive user account
41.description: A sign-in attempt was detected using a deceptive user account. A potential attacker might be using a fake or decoy user account on this device. Attackers might use the account to perform various attack activities, including lateral movement and accessing sensitive data.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
